targets.failed_criterion_detail: resistance_grows_with_interval (load-bearing): retained_fraction axis [0.389,0.536,0.749,0.592] over windows [0,150,400,900] is non-monotone (drop at n900). Between-arm deltas [+0.147,+0.213,-0.157] all within per-arm SEM (0.098-0.147); fixed 0.15 margin not scaled to noise. All install/readiness preconditions passed (install_took_fraction=1.0 on all arms).

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Muller-Pilzecker / Krakauer et al. 2005 time-dependent (retrograde-interference) consolidation
biological_reference.divergence: REE's protection pathways are awake/online/undifferentiated vs the biology's sleep/replay-dependent, trace-selective mechanisms; this run's design is agnostic to that divergence and does not resolve it either way.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-836b (2026-07-29, INTERVAL arm) self-routed non_monotone_interval_response, but is non_contributory, not mixed: the retained-fraction interval axis [0.389,0.536,0.749,0.592] over windows [0,150,400,900] is non-monotone only because of the drop at n900, and every between-arm delta (+0.147/+0.213/-0.157) sits inside the per-arm SEM (0.098-0.147) against a fixed, non-noise-scaled 0.15 margin; the n400 peak does not survive leave-one-out on its single extreme seed (retained_fraction=1.285, mean 0.749->0.642) (failure_autopsy_v3-exq-836b_2026-07-29). Same measurement_test_design_defect as siblings 836/836c. Superseded pending a 836b redo under a noise-scaled discrimination rule.

re_derive_brake.not_fired_reason: MECH-476's cluster is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling; R3 counts only substrate_ceiling. Brake does not fire.

learning_extracted: Fixed (non-noise-scaled) 0.15 discrimination margin at n=6 seeds is the same defect that felled 836 and 836c; the retained_fraction ratio DV is highly sensitive to single-seed RL-trajectory variance across the whole 836 family.
Existing dependency neither strengthened nor weakened: nothing here bears on whether consolidation is genuinely interval-dependent.

A redo should adopt a noise-scaled discrimination rule (margin scaled to the SD of the between-arm delta plus an absolute floor) uniformly across the 836 dose/interval/novelty family, not a per-arm fixed constant.
